permission_desc: GET /api/admin/audit-logs/{user_id}/ - List audit logs for one actor
POST /api/admin/users/ - Create a user as admin
POST /api/auth/login/ - Login and obtain JWT tokens
GET /api/auth/me/ - Get the authenticated user profile
POST /api/benefits/enrollments/ - Enroll in a benefit plan
GET /api/documents/ - List documents owned by the current user
GET /api/leaves/ - List leave requests owned by the current user
PATCH /api/leaves/{id}/ - Partially update a leave request
PUT /api/leaves/{id}/approve/ - Approve or reject a leave request
GET /api/payroll/{user_id}/ - List payroll records for a user
PUT /api/payroll/{user_id}/ - Create or update payroll for a user
POST /api/users/ - Create a user via the collection route
PATCH /api/users/{id}/ - Partially update a user profile
